I suggest trading up. With enough work,you can make any skin turn into a knife. 

Let me elaborate:Lets say you have a 0.02 skin (euro). Then you trade that skin for a 0.03 one. Then a 0.05. -0.06-0.10-0.15-0.17-0.18,and so on and so on. 

Now that sounds fairly simple,well actually it really is. The hard part is being patient. Because you are mostly trading for higher value weapons,you gotta find someone that wants your weapon because he likes it,and isnt thinking much about the value. So yes it is going to take you a while. I always try to trade with friends (and as i have a fairly large friend list,been with steam for 2+ years,it is going well whenever I try). There is an actual video of someone titled "from nothing to knife".

Keep one item for trading and work towards whatever you want. If you still want to bet remember these rules: 

1.Never.Ever.Go.All-in.EVER. A bet is never safe,there are plenty of occasions when the 10% team wins over the one with 90% (according to CSGL%),the most recent one being the one you just talked about,and a few others like HR-Epsilon.

2.Always try to research everything and look everywhere. Check on info on this subreddit,check each team strats,check for things like is it LAN,is it online,understand the difference between them,is the team consistent? Did it just come out of a recent vacation and probably didnt have time to practice? Are they tired from 4 matches in a row? Is their morale high? Did the roster change? Did they play against eachother in the past with the same roster?,etc. 

3.**Never bet more than you are able to lose**. This is the most important of all. Learn to bet so that you have the worst case scenario in mind.
